entities.summary: Claudia Ruiz Massieu Salinas is a Mexican lawyer and politician affiliated with the Citizens' Movement Party. She served as Secretary of Foreign Affairs following her appointment by President Enrique Peña Nieto in 2015 to which she resigned on 4 January 2017.
